Voting by Armed Forces 
 
596. Shri G.V.L. Narasimha Rao: 
 
Will the Minister of Law and Justice be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  whether voting options are available to armed forces personnel posted in 
various locations, detail thereof; 
(b)  whether armed forces personnel are eligible to register as ordinarily resident 
voters in parliamentary constituency of places of posting; 
(c)  if so, process involved in registration and voting in parliamentary 
constituency at place of posting and if not, reasons 
therefor; 
(d)  whether Supreme Court judgments in this regard are being followed, if not, 
reasons therefor; 
(e)  number of eligible voters in armed forces in 2019 and number who voted in 
2019 parliamentary elections; and 
(f)  steps taken for increased participation of armed forces personnel in elections? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF LAW AND JUSTICE 
(SHRI KIREN RIJIJU) 
 
(a) 
& (b):   Yes Sir, a  service voter has the option of voting through postal ballot or 
through a proxy, duly appointed by him. Persons having a service 
qualification can get enrolled as 'service voters' at their native places even 
though they actually may be residing at the pla ce of posting which is different 
from their native place. Further, service voters have an option to get 
themselves enrolled as general elector at the place of their posting if that is a 
peace station. 
 
 (c): Service personnel (other than those who are employed under the Government 
of India in a post outside India) has a choice to get himself registered as 
general elector in the roll of concerned part/polling station of the assembly 
constituency in which the ac tual place of his posting and residence is located, 
subject to the condition that his/her place of posting is a peace station. Option 
of enrolment as general elector is not available to the service personnel posted 
420

at forward stations.  Those service personnel cannot be registered as a general 
elector at his native place. 
 
Service personnel who intends to get himself/herself registered as general 
elector at his/her place of posting, he/she has to make an application in Form -
6 before the Electoral Registration Officer of the Assembly Constituency in 
which he/she ordinarily resides due to his/her posting at peace station. 
 
Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) after satisfying himself that the 
applicant fulfils all the eligibility criteria fixed for registration and otherwise 
he/she is not disqualified for registration, on the basis of available 
documents/testimonials and after conducting enquiry, if required, passes 
speaking order after expiry of 7 days' notice period for registration in the 
electoral roll. 
 
After getting enrolled in the electoral roll as a general elector, the elector 
concerned is entitled to vote at an Assembly constituency/Parliamentary 
Constituency.  
 
(d): Supreme Court judgment s are invariably followed. 
 
(e): Statement reflecting state -wise number of registered service electors in the 
last part of final electoral roll with reference to 01.01.2019 is enclosed at 
(Annexure-A). 
 
(f): Consultations and meetings have been held with stakeholders since 2015 to 
enhance participation of Service Voters, mainly the defense and paramilitary 
personnel.  A detailed Systematic Voters Education and Electoral 
Participation (SVEEP) strategy was developed in 2017 for the Service Voters 
and interventions rolled out. Various wings of Armed Forces and Paramilitary 
have been coordinated with to monitor their part of the action plan. CEOS 
have rolled out the plan in respective cantonment areas to reach the target 
audience. 
 
As an important component of the strategy, to promote electoral registration 
and voting through postal ballot by members of the Indian armed forces, an 
informative and motivational film was produced through National Film 
Development Corpo ration. The film consists of vivid action -packed visuals 
which were shot at actual locations so that it resonates with the lives of armed 
personnel. There is an inspirational  song with upbeat music towards the end 
of the film which has become very popular. 
 
Along with the film, an informative brochure and dedicated posters for 
different armed forces such as Coast Guards, Army, Navy, Air Force, CRPF 
etc. were also produced and dispatched to their centers in large numbers for 
dispersal. 
 
421

During the Lok Sabha Elections 2019, designated radio spots on participation 
and facilitation of service voters were created and popularized across all 
social media handles as well as the official website. Further, various audio 
visual creatives, posters were also produced and widely circulated. A 
brochure titled "How do I vote"-a guide for service voters was also made 
wherein all the details regard ing service voters registration, Electronically 
Transferable Postal Ballot (ETPB), filing ballot paper etc. were mentioned. 
All the content is available on ECI YouTube Channel. 
 
All social media handles of ECI such as twitter, facebook and instagram have 
been actively uploading post on service voters from time to time. Further, The 
Hon'ble President of India officially launched the Hello Voters (Web Radio) 
on NVD 2021 to expand the scope of its digital outreach interventions. A 
dedicated episode to service voters has also been produced on web radio.

(b) if so, the details thereof and the action taken by Government to achieve this goal; and

MINISTER OF STATE (INDEPENDENT CHARGE) OF THE

(a) & (b) Yes Sir, one of the key elements of the Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Policy 
2013, is to position India among the top five global scientific powers. The government has taken 
several initiatives to achieve this goal viz., successive increase in budget allocations for scientific 
departments, creation of Centres of Excellence and other facilities in emerging and frontline areas of

take up innovation at global standards. The key highlights of the STI Policy-2013 were to promote 
an S&T - led innovation ecosystem in the country, attract private sector investment into R&D and 
link STI to socio-economic priorities.  The decade from 2010 to 2020 was declared as the ‘Decade of 
Innovation’ with the agenda to create an effective National Innovation Ecosystem. The development 
of the national science, technology and innovation ecosystem has been marked with a significant 
increase in R&D investment, a rise in publication ranking, and a steady increase in institutional and 
human capacity. India currently ranks 3rd in terms of total number of publications based on the 
National Science Foundation (USA) database and 9th (from 14th in 2011) in terms of quality of 
research publications. The Gross Expenditure on Research & Development (GERD) has increased 
more than three times in the last 10 years. India has witnessed a massive jump in its Global Innovation 
Index (GII) ranking from 81st in the year 2015 to 46th in 2021 among 130 economies of the world.

Technology (DST, DST & DSIR/CSIR) for implementing various programmes and schemes during

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.616 
ANSWERED ON 21.07.2022 
 
NEW SCHEME TO PROMOTE TOURISM 
 
616. DR. SONAL MANSINGH:   
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has prepared any new scheme to promote tourism; 
(b) whether Government has taken any steps to create jobs under the tourism sector; and  
(c) if so, the plans made to achieve this goal, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM           (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY) 
 
(a) to (c): Ministry of Tourism promotes tourism through its ongoing schemes of 
“Domestic Promotion and Publicity including Hospitality” (DPPH) and “Overseas Promotion 
and Publicity including Market Development Assistance” (OPMD), in the domestic and 
overseas market. Besides, the Ministry, through its Schemes of “Swadesh Darshan” and 
“National Mission on Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive”-
PRASHAD provides financial as sistance to State Governments/ Union Territory (UT) 
Administrations, in consultation with them for the development of tourism infrastructure, 
which contributes to the creation of jobs in the tourism sector.  
 
Besides, the Ministry has taken several other steps to boost the tourism sector which 
creates jobs in the sector as per details given below:-  
i. Launched the Adopt a Heritage Project for development and maintenance of tourist 
amenities at heritage sites/monuments and other tourist sites.  
ii. Providing facility of e-Visa for 5 sub-categories i.e. e-Tourist visa, e-Business visa, e-
Medical visa, e -Medical Attendant visa and e -Conference visa for nationals of 156 
countries. 
iii. Launched Incredible India Tourist Facilitator Programme, a Pan -India digital 
initiative to provide basic, advanced, spoken foreign language and refres her courses 
for creating a pool of trained and certified tourist facilitators which would help in 
creating employment opportunities at the local level. 
iv. Conducting Programmes under the „Capacity Building for Service Providers‟ (CBSP) 
Scheme to train and up -grade manpower to create employable capacity in the tourism 
sector both in urban as well as rural areas.

MINISTRY OF TOURISM 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.620 
ANSWERED ON 21.07.2022 
 
INDIA TOURISM DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION 
 
620. SHRI JOSE K. MANI: 
        
  Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the structure and operation characteristic of the India Tourism Development 
Corporation (ITDC); 
(b) tourism operations that are carried out at present by the ITDC; 
(c) whether there is any understanding or mechanism by which tourism operations are 
made without overlapping with tourism development corporations of States; and 
(d) whether Government has negotiated with private airline o
perators for the facilitation 
of providing cheap tickets to different tourism destinations, if so, the details thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM                                                (SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY) 
 
(a):  ITDC is “one stop solution provider” in the Hospitality, Travel and Tourism sector 
contributing towards fulfilling the overall objective of development, promotion and expansion 
of domestic as well as international tourism in the country. ITDC has been the prime mover in 
the progressive development, promotion and expansion of tourism in the country.  
 
ITDC is running hotels, restaurants at various places for tourists (Hotels), besides 
providing transport facilities (ITDC-Ashok Travels & Tours /ATT), duty free shopping 
facilities (ITDC-Ashok International Trade Division/AITD) to the tourists, event management 
services (ITDC-Ashok Events Division/ AED), engineering related consultancy services 
(Ashok Consultancy and Engineering Services/ACES Division) and mounting of Sound & 
Light Shows (ITDC-SEL/Son Et Lumiere Division). The Ashok Institute of Hospitality & 
Tourism Management (ITDC-AIHTM) of the Corporation imparts training and education in 
the field of tourism and hospitality. ITDC is also managing catering services at Western 
Court, Vigyan Bhawan, Hyderabad House and Parliament House. To reinvent itself in the 
changing scenario, ITDC besides consolidating its remaining business area, diversified into 
new service-oriented business activities like consultancy and execution of tourism and 
engineering projects, training/education in the tourism and hospitality sectors. 
 
 
(b):  ITDC-Hotels: At present, ITDC Hotels Division is running the following Units: 
 
 The Ashok Hotel, New Delhi 
 Samrat Hotel, New Delhi 
 Hotel Kalinga Ashok, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 
 Hotel Jammu Ashok (operations closed), Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir (J&K)   
 Taj Restaurant, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 
474

 Ashok Beach Resort, Puducherry, Joint Venture (JV) of ITDC & Pondicherry 
Industrial Promotion Development and Investment Corporation Limited/PIPDICL  
 Hotel Ranchi Ashok, Ranchi, Jharkhand, JV of ITDC & Bihar State Tourism 
Development Corporation/ BSTDC (operations closed)   
 Hotel Nilachal Ashok Puri, Odisha, JV of ITDC & Odisha Tourism Development 
Corporation/OTDC (Operations Closed)  
 
ATT Division of ITDC is in business of air ticketing, transport and tours. ITDC-ATT is 
running its operations as per memorandum and articles of association.  
 
AED of ITDC executes events of Ministry of Tourism (MoT) as per the Memorandum of 
Understanding/ MoU with the MoT. 
 
AIH&TM the Human Resources Development/HRD Division of ITDC is not conducting 
tourism operations directly. However, providing quality training to hospitality professional 
involved in tourism activities. The division conducts several skill development training 
programes sponsored by Ministry of Tourism like Hunar Se Rozgar, Skill Testing and 
Certification, Entrepreneurship Program and Tourism Awareness Programme. 
 
 
AITD of ITDC has 15 Duty Free shops at Seaports.  
 
ACES Division of ITDC undertakes various projects sanctioned by MoT and State 
Govts. for development and expansion of tourism in the country. ACES division since its 
inception has been providing services from Concept to Commissioning of Tourism 
Infrastructure Development, Hotels, Educational, Landscaping, River Front Development 
Projects etc. The division also prepares Detailed Project Reports, Feasibility & Pre –
 
Feasibility Reports, Cost- Benefit Analysis. Preparation of Drawings, Estimates & Tender 
documents for development of Tourism Infrastructure. The division executes various 
Tourism Infrastructure Projects under MoT Central Flagship schemes such as Swadesh 
Darshan and Central Financial Assistance/CFA Schemes and other State Govts also.  
 
SEL/Multimedia shows and musical fountains are implemented by this division of 
ITDC. 
 
(c):  So far as ITDC-ATT Division is concerned, it is in business of air ticketing, transport 
and tours. ATT is running its operations as per memorandum and articles of association.  
 
So far as AITD of ITDC is concerned, no State Tourism Corporations are in the 
business of the Duty Free shops. 
 
 
(d): No, Sir.  Ministry of Tourism has not negotiated with any private Airlines Operator.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.624 
ANSWERED ON 21.07.2022 
 
DEVELOPMENT OF DARJEELING HILLS AS INTERNATIONAL TOURIST 
DESTINATION 
 
624. SMT. SHANTA CHHETRI: 
 
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is considering to develop Darjeeling hills as international tourist 
destination owing to its unique natural beauty and Himalayan Railway declared as 
UNESCO World Heritage; 
(b)  whether Government will consider Darjeeling hills within the Swadesh Darshan 
Scheme; and 
(c)  if so, the details thereof, and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF TOURISM          
(SHRI G. KISHAN REDDY) 
 
(a) to (c): Ministry of Tourism under schemes of ‘Swadesh Darshan’, ‘National Mission 
on Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual, Heritage Augmentation Drive (PRASHAD)’  and 
Assistance to Central Agencies provides financial Assistance to State Governments/Union 
Territories/Central Agencies for developing tourism infrastructure in the country including 
West Bengal. The projects under the above schemes are identified for development in 
consultation with the State Governments/UT Administrations/Central Agencies and are 
sanctioned subject to availability of funds, submission of suitable detailed project reports, 
adherence to scheme guidelines and utilization of funds released earlier etc. 
 
The 
Ministry of Tourism has now revamped its Swadesh Darshan scheme as Swadesh 
Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0) with the objective to develop sustainable and responsible destinations 
following a tourist & destination centric approach. As of now, no proposal for development 
of Darjeeling has been received under SD2.0

1          Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS) :  The Programmes/ Activities of NYKS broadly fall in

a. Core Programmes:  These include Training on Youth Leadership and Community Development, 
Theme-based Awareness and Education Programme, Promotion of Sports, Skill Up-gradation 
Training Programme, District Youth Convention and Yuva Kriti, etc. 
b. Programmes organised with fun ding from  NPYAD:  These include  National Integration Camps 
(NICs), Youth Leadership and Personality Development Programmes (YLPDPs), Life Skill 
Training Programmes and Adventure Camps. 
c. Programmes organised with funding from other Ministries/ Organisations : These include  Tribal 
Youth Exchange Programmes, Adolescent Health and Development Project (AHDP), Projects on 
Awareness and Education for Prevention of Drug Abuse and Alcoholism in Punjab, etc. 
d. Programmes in coordination with various Departments/ Agencies : NYKS does not receive any 
funding, but organizes/ participates in various programmes in coordination with various 
Development Departments/ Agencies. Some such activities are blood donation, plantation of 
saplings, organization of health/ eye/ immunization camps, enrolment of children in schools, etc. 
  
2          National Youth Corps (NYC):  youth in the age-group of 18-29 years are engaged as volunteers to 
serve upto maximum 2 years in nation-building activities.  They act as an extended arm of NYKS in the 
Block 
and play an active role in implementation of various programmes and initiatives of NYKS through 
youth clubs. 
  
3          National Programme for Youth and Adolescent Development (NPYAD): Financial assistance is 
provided to Government/ non-Government organisations for taking up activities for youth and adolescent 
development. The assistance under NPYAD is provided under 5 major components, namely, Youth 
Leadership and Personality Development Training, Promotion of National Integration (National Integration 
Camps, Inter-State Youth Exchange Programmes, Youth Festivals, multi-cultural activities, etc.), 
Promotion of Adventure; Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards, Development and Empowerment 
of Adolescents (Life Skills Education, Counselling, Career Guidance, etc.) and Technical and Resource 
Development (Research and Studies on Youth issues, Documentation, Seminars/ Workshops) 
  
4          International Cooperation:  Exchange of Youth Delegations with friendly countries is taken up 
for promoting exchange of ideas, values and culture amongst the youth of different countries and also to 
promote peace and understanding. It helps in developing international perspective among the youth. 
  
5          Youth Hostels: Youth Hostels are built to promote youth travel within the country with low cost, 
budget accommodation and facilities to travelling students and youth groups on excursions or study tours.  
The aim of the scheme is to encourage youth travel to know more about the diversity of India’s culture and 
people.  Youth Hostels are generally established, in locations of historical, cultural and tourist interest and 
significance. 
  
6         Assistance to Scouting and Guiding Organizations: The Department provides assistance to the 
Scouting and Guiding Organizations, with a view to promote the Scouts and Guides movement in the

IMPLEMENTATION OF NEW LABOUR LAWS 
 
636. # SMT. GEETA ALIAS CHANDRAPRABHA: 
 
 Will the Minister of Labour and Employment  be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a) whether new labour laws are being enforced in the country; 
(b) if so, the extent to which these laws shall be different from the 
previous laws, the details thereof; and 
(c) the details of the benefits accruing to the workers from these 
laws? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) to (c): The Government has formulated four Labour Codes, namely, 
the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the 
Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and 
Working Conditions Code, 2020.  
 
The Labour Codes have been aligned with the present 
economic scenario and technological advancements along with 
reduction in multiplicity of definitions & authorities. The Codes also 
ease compliance mechanism aiming to promote ease of doing 
business/setting up of enterprises and catalyze creation of 
employment opportunities while ensuring safety, health and social 
security of every worker. Use of technology, such as, web-based 
Inspection has been introduced in order to ensure transparency & 
accountability in enforcement. Decriminalization of minor offences has 
also been provided in the Labour Codes.  
Contd..2/-

:: 2 :: 
 
The Codes inter alia extend a number of benefits to workers 
some of which are as follows: - 
 
 Statutory right to all workers for minimum wages and timely 
payment of wages. 
 Annual health check and Appointment letter for employees. 
 Women are now entitled to work in the night, subject to their 
consent, with provisions of safety and holidays. 
 Employees’ State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) coverage on 
voluntary basis for establishments having less than 10 employees has 
been introduced.  
 Benefits under ESIC can also be made applicable through 
notification to an establishment which carries on hazardous or life 
threatening occupation in which even a single employee is employed.  
 Extension of benefits to unorganised workers, gig workers and 
platform workers and the members of their families through ESIC or 
Employees’ Provident Fund Organization (EPFO).  
 Setting up of Social Security Fund for formulating schemes for 
welfare of the unorganised workers, gig workers and platform workers.   
 A provision for worker reskilling fund has been made for re-
skilling the retrenched workers which provides for crediting fifteen 
days’ wages last drawn by the worker.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF YOUTH AFFAIRS & SPORTS 
(DEPARTMENT OF SPORTS) 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO-640 
ANSWERED ON- 21/07/2022 
 
INCENTIVES AVAILABLE TO THE SPORTS PERSONS 
 
 
640 SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI: 
 
 
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to state:- 
 
(a) the details of incentives available to the sports persons in the country;  
(b) the number of sports persons of national and international repute who have been offered central 
Government jobs during the last five years, the details thereof; and  
(c) to what extent the sports persons were exposed to coaching and training from foreign coaches/ 
trainers and equipment, the details thereof ? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
 
THE MINISTER FOR YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS  
(SHRI ANURAG SINGH THAKUR) 
 
(a) The Government provides the following types of incentives to the sportspersons through its 
various schemes: 
i. Scheme of Cash Awards to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and  their 
Coaches. The Objective of the scheme is to incentivize the achievements of outstanding 
sportspersons, encourage and motivate them for higher achievements and to act as inspiring 
role models for attracting the younger generation to take up sports. Un der this scheme, cash 
award ranging  from Rs.20,000/- to Rs.75,00,000/- is provided to the sportsperson. 
ii.  Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya National Welfare Fund for Sportspersons (PDUNWFS). 
The Objective of the scheme is to assist outstanding sportsp ersons living in indigent 
circumstances, for medical treatment, purchase of equipment etc. Under this scheme , 
financial assistance ranging from  Rs.2,00,000/ - to Rs.10,00,000/ - is provided to the 
sportsperson/family member as per the provisions of the scheme.
526

iii. Scheme of Pension to Meritorious Sportsperson . The objective of the scheme is to 
provide assured monthly income through annuity for outstanding sportspersons that has 
become imperative due to the fact that sportspersons spend prime of their youth in pursuit 
of intensive training, sacrificing other beneficial opportunities normally available. The 
assured monthly income will be a compensation for the opportunities spurned by them in 
pursuit of their high ambition and achievement in sports. Under the sche me monthly 
pension ranging from Rs.12,000/- to Rs.20,000/- is provided to the ex-sportsperson. 
iv. National Sports Awards 
(1) Major Dhyan  Chand Khel Ratna Award introduced in 1991 -92 to recognize the 
spectacular and most outstanding performance in the field of sports by a sportsperson over 
a period of four years immediately preceding the year. The awardees are given a statuette, 
a certificate, ceremonial dress and award money of ₹25 lakhs.  
(2) Arjuna Award was instituted in 1961 and is given to players who have exhibited good 
performance consistently for the previous four years at the international level and have 
shown qualities of leadership, sportsmanship and a sense of discipline. The awardees are 
given a statuette, a certificate, ceremonial dress and award money of ₹15 lakhs.  
(3) Dronacharya Award was instituted in 1985 to honour eminent coaches who have done 
outstanding and meritorious work on a consistent basis and enabled sportspersons to excel 
in International events and to motivate coaches to dedicate themselves with a singularity 
of purpose of raising the standard of sportspersons to highest performance in International 
events and thus bring glory to the country. The awardees are given a statuette, a certificate, 
ceremonial dress and a cash prize of ₹15 lakhs (lifetime) and ₹10 lakhs (Regular).  
(4) Dhyan Chand Award was instituted in 2002 to honour those sportspersons who have 
contributed to sports by their performance and continue to contribute to promotion of sports 
even after their retirement from active sporting career. The awardees are given a statuette, 
a certificate, ceremonial dress and award money of ₹10 lakh.  
(5) Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy was instituted as a running trophy in 1956 -57 and 
is given to top overall performing university which has given the best all round 
performance during the year of award in the inter -university tournament. The winner 
receives a replica of the Trophy, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹15 lakhs. First runner up 
and second runner up universities receives cash prize of ₹ 7.5 lakhs  and ₹ 4.5 lakhs 
respectively.  
(6) Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar was established in 2009 and is awarded to  
Corporates, voluntary organizations, Sports Control Boards, NGOs, Sports bodies at State 
and National level for promotion and development of Sports in four categories (a) 
Identification and Nurturing of Budding and Young Talent (b) Encouragement to sports  
through Corporate Social Responsibility (c) Employment of sportspersons and sports 
welfare measures (d) Sports for Development. 
v. Khelo India Programme  has twin objectives of mass participation and promotion of 
excellence in sports . A financial assistance @  Rs. 6,28,400 (including Rs. 1,20,000 as 
OPA) per annum per athlete is being provided to the Khelo India Academies for training 
of the selected Khelo India athletes. 
 
 
527

vi. Under the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) , the Government provides 
assistance to India’s top athletes in their preparations for Olympic and Paralympic Games. 
At present, 162 individual athletes & 2 hockey teams (M&W) as core group have been 
selected under the scheme. Also, Under Development Group to ensure a focused approach 
in India’s Olympic preparation the talent identification of 254 best sporting talents has been 
completed. Out-of-pocket allowance of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) a month 
to the TOPS Core Group athletes and Rs. 25, 000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand only) a 
month to the TOPS Development Group athletes is given. 
 
(b) There is provision for employment in Central Government for sportspersons who represents 
India in the Olympics. As per the guidelines of Department of Personnel and Training (DOP&T), 
meritorious sportspersons, including Olympians, are eligible for appointment under Sports Quota 
with provision for up to 5% reservation in Group C and Group D posts in Central Government 
Departments. As Sports is a State subje ct, State Governments follow their own policies for 
appointment of meritorious sportspersons in the respective State Governments.  
 
(c) Government provides assistance to elite sportspersons preparing for major international events 
such as Olympic Games, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games etc. by providing funding 
support through its Scheme of Assistance to National Sports Federations (NSF s). Under the 
Scheme of Assistance to National Sports Federations, identified promising sportspersons/teams 
are provided all requisite facilities for their preparations including wholesome nutritious diet, food 
supplements, equipments, state-of-the-art infrastructure, lodging, travelling facilities, services of 
reputed Indian and Foreign Coaches/supporting staff, scientific & medical support, sports kit, etc. 
besides financial assistance for their training abroad and participation in international competitions 
in India and abroad.  
Equipment support is provided to the athletes in their respective sport disciplines under 
Assistance to NSF for National camps as per the proposals received. Also, specific equipment 
requested by athlete for training & competition  are provided as recommended by NSFs under 
TOPS.

 क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह बताने की क ृऩा करेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  क्या सरकार के ऩास गत ऩांच वर्षों के दौरान राजस्थान, ददल्ऱी, झारखंड, छत्तीसगढ़ और

(ग) सरकार द्वारा बच्चों को बाऱ मजद ूर के रूऩ में काम ऩर रखने ऩर रोक ऱगाने के लऱए क्या

श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्ऱी 
 
(श्ऱी रामेश्वर तेऱी) 
 
(क ) और (ख): राष्ट्रीय अऩराध ररकाडा ब्यूरो के प्रकार्न “क्राइम इन इंडडया, 2020” के अनुसार बाऱ 
और ककर्ोर श्रम (प्रततर्षेध और ववतनयमन) अधधतनयम, 1986 के अंतगात ववगत ऩांच वर्षों अथाात 
2016 से 2020 के दौरान राजस्थान, झारखंड, ऩश्चचम बंगाऱ और राष्ट्रीय राजधानी ऺेत्र ददल्ऱी में

(ग): बच्चों को बाऱ श्रलमकों के रूऩ में तनयोश्जत होने से रोकने के लऱए सरकार ने कई कदम 
उठाए हैं, और इनमें तनम्नलऱखखत र्ालमऱ हैं:- 
 
 
(i) बाऱ श्रम (प्रततर्षेध और ववतनयमन) संर्ोधन अधधतनयम, 2016 का अधधतनयमन , श्जसमें 
14 वर्षा से कम उम्र के बच्चों को ककसी भी व्यवसाय/ प्रकक्रया में तनयोजन ऩर प्रततबंध 
ऱगाने के उऩबंध हैं । इसमें अधधतनयम के उल्ऱंघन के लऱए तनयो क्ताओं के लऱए कडी

(ii) बाऱ श्रम (प्रततर्षेध और ववतनयमन) संर्ोधन केन्द्रीय तनयम बनाना।  
(iii) संबंधधत राज्य सरकारों द्वारा की जाने वाऱी कारावाई के बबंद ु की स ूची सदहत आदर्ा 
राज्य कारावाई योजना तैयार करना ।

560. प्रो. मनोज कुमार झा: 
क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह बताने की कृऩा करेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  वषष 2019-20, 2020-21 और 2021 -22 में श्रम ववभाग के माध्यम से प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा

(ख) प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा (संशोधन) अधधतनयम, 2017 के तहत संचामऱत ककए जा रहे मशश ु गृहों की

उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री रामेश्वर तेऱी) 
 
(क):  प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा अधधतनयम , 1961, प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा (संशोधन) अधधतनयम , 2017 द्वारा 
यथासंशोधधत , में अन्य बातों के साथ -साथ महहऱा कामगारों के मऱए सवेतन प्रस ूतत अवकाश तथा 
संस्थानों द्वारा मशशु-गृह स ुववधाओं के  उऩबंध ककए गए हैं। यह अधधतनयम केन्रीय सरकार के साथ 
साथ सम ुधचत सरकार के रूऩ में राज्य सरकार द्वारा भी अऩने-अऩने ऺेत्रों में कियान्न्वत ककया जाता 
है, न्जसमें खदानों, कारखानों व तनमाषण -ऺेत्र में ऱगे प्रततष्ठान भी शाममऱ हैं। 
 
        कमषचारी राज्य बीमा (ईएसआई) अधधतनयम, 1948 के उऩबंधों के अंतगषत शाममऱ महहऱा 
कामगारों को भी प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा  प्रदान ककया जाता है। प्रत्येक महहऱा, जो प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा

तक कवर की जाती है जब तक कक वह ईएसआई अधधतनयम , 1948 के तहत प्रसूतत प्रसुववधा का 
दावा करने के मऱए योग्य नहीं हो जाती।

561. प्रो. मनोज कुमार झा: 
   
 क्या श्रम और रोजगार मंत्री यह बताने की क ृऩा करेंगे कक:  
 
(क)  क्या सरकार इस बात से अवगत है कक देश में क ुछ कंऩननयां राष्ट्रीय मजदूरी ननयमों का

(ख) क्या सरकार ने इस प्रकार के उल्ऱंघन का डाटाबेस रखा है , यदद हां , तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; 
और   
(ग) क्या ननयम का अन ुऩाऱन नहीं ककए जाने के कारण व्यथिथत ऱोगों को कोई ऺनतऩ ूनति  प्रदान की 
गई है, तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री  
(श्री रामेश्वर तेऱी) 
 
(क) से (ग): न्यूनतम मजद ूरी अथिधननयम, 1948 के उऩबंधों के तहत , क ें द्र और राज्य दोनों सरकारें

(घ) क्या सरकार एनसीएऱऩी के अंतगषत बचाए गए बच्चों को स्कूऱ जाने के लऱए मालसक व ृल्त्त

श्रम और रोजगार राज्य मंत्री

(क): राष्ट्रीय बाऱ श्रम ऩररयोजना (एनसीएऱऩी) स्कीम को ददनांक 31.03.2021 तक जारी रखने की 
मंजूरी दी गई थी एवं तब से इसे ल्जऱा और राज्य स्तर ऩर प्रयासों के दोहराव से बचने के लऱए 
चरणबद्ध तरीके से लिऺा मंत्राऱय की समग्र लिऺा अलियान (एसएसए) स्कीम के साथ सल्ममलऱत/ 
ववऱनयत कर ददया गया है। एसएसए ल्जऱे के सिी ‘स्कूऱ नहीं जाने वाऱे’ बच्चों की देख -रेख करती 
है, ल्जन्हें एसएसए के वविेर् प्रलिऺण क ें द्रों (एसटीसी) के माध्यम से मुख्यधारा में ऱाया जाता है। 
(ख): एनसीएऱऩी के ददिा -ननद ेिों के अन ुसार, ल्जऱा ऩररयोजना सोसायटी और एसटीसी में कायषरत 
कालमषक स्वयंसेवक होते हैं, जो ऩहचान ककए गए बाऱ श्रलमकों के लऱए समायोजी लिऺा प्रदान करने 
के लऱए खो ऱे गए एसटीसी का संचाऱन करते हैं।  एसटीसी के लऱए अध्याऩन स्वयंसेवकों और ल्जऱा 
ऩररयोजना सोसायटी के अन्य स्वयंसेवकों को स्ऩष्ट्ट सहमनत/ समझौते के साथ ननयोल्जत ककया जाता 
है कक उन्हें उनकी सेवाएं , जो स्वैल्च्िक प्रकृनत की हैं , के लऱए केवऱ मानदेय की एक समेककत रालि

ईपीएफ से कवर ककसी प्रनतष्ठान में ननयोनजत नहीं र्थे , वे भी लाभ क े  नलए पात्र हैं। 
 भारत सरकार , ईपीएफओ से पंजीक ृ त प्रनतष्ठानों की कमगचारी संख्या क े  आिार पर, कमगचाटरयों क े  अंशदान 
(वेतन का 12%) तर्था ननयोक्ता क े  देय अंशदान (वेतन का 12%)-दोनों 
का अर्थवा क े वल कमगचाटरयों का 
अंशदान 2 वषग क े  नलए वहन कर रही है।  
 यह योजना कदनांक 01 अक्िूबर 2020 से आरंभ की गई र्थी और पात्र ननयोक्ताओं और नए कमगचाटरयों क े नलए 
पंजीकरण 31 माचग 2022 तक चालू र्था।  
 
इस योजना का लक्ष्य क ु ल 71.80 लाख सदस्यों को लाभ पहुंचाना र्था। इस योजना क े  तहत क ु ल पंजीक ृ त 75.11 
लाख है। कदनांक 13.07.2022 तक , देश में 1.50 लाख प्रनतष्ठानों क े माध्यम से 59.54 लाख लाभार्र्थगयों को लाभ प्रदान 
ककया गया है।  
योजना का दायरा बढ़ाने क े नलए, पंजीकरण की अंनतम नतनर्थ को नौ माह अर्थागत् कदनांक 20.06.2021 से 
कदनांक 31.03.2022 तक बढ़ाया गया र्था।
